name: Mahou Shoujo Meruru ~Kamigami no Shihou o Motomete~
original_name: 魔法少女メルル～神々の至宝を求めて～
source:
Meruru is sent on a journey to collect 3 jewels for master wizard. But she's so light-minded that she forgot to take map with her. Young sorcerer Nicola catches up with her bringing the map and joins her on this journey.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
梅露露被派去为大魔法师收集3颗宝石。但她太粗心了，忘了带地图。年轻的魔法师尼古拉带着地图追上了她，并加入了这段旅程。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
